inputs.name: documents and files of any format, and existing collections of them, from the organisation or from its other systems
inputs.format: file, received through the Input socket

inputs.name: a contributor's own words, by text, chat or voice
inputs.format: conversation, recorded only after the contributor approves a preview of the exact text

inputs.name: a request from a connected part, including a request for a source that is missing
inputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), received through the tool gateway

inputs.name: needs requests from a connected design stage, one thing and one decision per row, each pass with its report of what is still missing
inputs.format: Work Item sub-items (ID + version) under the published sockets contract, received through the tool gateway

inputs.name: filings of a design stage, only of its own origin kind (operating model; process and position design; delivery and implementation) and design report, on behalf of a named HOAC position that holds a current contributor agreement
inputs.format: content-addressed source, received through the tool gateway within the stage's write scope

inputs.name: exports of records of the work as it runs, only as the organisation's own projection by role-type and process, after an impact assessment and the data-protection decision (HF-17); an export that still says who did the work is refused
inputs.format: source, recorded as origin kind export with its date

inputs.name: from the Operations Event Register: filings of origin kind correspondence (a formal item kept as received, because a position asked to keep its register entry, with the entry's content hash) and export (its projection of the work by role-type and process, under the rule for records of the work); gap signals, one per act done without a source, by reference to the register entry; and reads of references only (never content) of the sources its entries cite, under its signed grant
inputs.format: content-addressed source within the register's write scope, and Work Item (ID + version) for a gap signal, received through the tool gateway

outputs.name: the organisation's sources: registered, referenced, classified and fixed, each with its status
answers to a connected part, by reference only: held or not held, within the scope approved by the [ORG]HOAC-ACS seat that [ORG]AIOC-SL is accountable to
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: what the organisation is missing, and the state of each request for a missing source
needs answers by reference, each routed to and answered by a position, never a named person; a row of a listed type decided only with its signature at the tool gateway
outputs.format: needs answer under the published sockets contract, sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: notices to a connected part of every revocation, narrowing, reclassification or supersession that affects a reference it read, naming each reference and version, never the content
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: the organisation dictionary, its own terms with their definitions and sources, served by reference to every design stage; and the essentials checklist, flagging what the organisation's sources should hold, shown beside a Design Request when it is put for approval; never drafted for the owner
outputs.format: versioned source (dictionary) and versioned gap list, by reference

outputs.name: to the Operations Event Register: references only (ID, version, status, held or not held) of the sources its entries cite, and notices for every version an entry cites; never content
outputs.format: source reference and notice, sent through the tool gateway
